utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m already lining folks up for the repair drive this weekend—I’ll start with Maple and Cedar this afternoon and pass along the yeses once I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn—and sorry I’m late. That sounds great; send me the yeses when you’ve got them, and I’ll match people up with the tool-sorting and parts table.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it—I’ll make the rounds on Maple and Cedar this afternoon and send over the confirmed houses so you can slot folks in fast.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve got the outline started—tools, pickup times, and the storage spot. If Eli’s got anything to add, I can bring the list by after.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works, Rey—bring the list by after, and make sure it clearly says what folks should bring and when the repair drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Alright, I’ll add what folks should bring and the start time, then I’ll bring the list by after so we can look it over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That still helps a lot, Faye — if you can, take a shift checking the sorted tools between pickup runs, and I’ll keep track of anything we’re missing parts for.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I can do a tool-check shift right after drop-off and then again before pickup if needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I’m helping round people up for the repair drive this afternoon—if you’re interested, I can point you to Ira and spread the word on your side too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — tell folks it’s the repair drive, what to bring, and when it starts this afternoon, and I’ll keep repeating that around the block so more neighbors hear.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: You got it—I’ll make sure folks know it’s the repair drive, what to bring, and when it starts this afternoon, and I’ll send anyone interested over to Ira too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Tell Pia I’ve still got my ladder and drill set aside for the repair drive if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s useful, but I need a clear list first—who’s picking them up, when, and where they’ll be stored so nothing gets misplaced.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Fair enough, Pia—I can bring the ladder and drill to the church shed Saturday morning, and if you tell me who’s checking them out, we’ll keep it all straight.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Quinn’s handling the outreach on Maple and Cedar, and once he sends me the confirmed houses, I’ll map who’s in on each stretch of the block.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Opal — once you’ve got that mapped, send it my way and I’ll fold it into the repair drive list so we can spot any gaps quickly.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — as soon as Quinn sends the Maple and Cedar confirmations, I’ll map them by stretch and pass it over so you can check for gaps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hana, do you know who’s actually running the signup list, and whether they’ve started canvassing the rest of the block yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet, Mina—I’d want to confirm who’s managing the signup list before saying they’ve started canvassing. Do you know who last had the clipboard?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: No, I don’t—that’s what I’m trying to pin down. If nobody knows who had the clipboard last, who should we ask first to track it down?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can handle the tool pickup first—you can count on me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Sam—while you do that, I’ve got Noah down for one roll of tape and two pairs of gloves, and I’m leaving trash bags unchecked until he confirms.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ll take care of the tool pickup first and let you know as soon as it’s sorted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard it second-hand, Noah, but I think about eight homes are signed up so far. I’m not sure who’s handling the list or whether they’ve started knocking on the rest of the block yet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—Cleo’s keeping the supply list straight, I think. I still need a roll of tape and two pairs of gloves, and I’m blanking on whether I already got the trash bags.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—so Cleo’s on supplies, at least; I still haven’t heard who’s actually coordinating signups, though. If you want, I can ask around and see whether anyone’s started going door to door yet.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, thanks for confirming. Tess, can we count on the rest of the repair drive lining up once Sam grabs the tools?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’d say so, Kira—folks are really pulling together, and once Sam grabs Gus’s ladder and drill, the rest ought to fall into place pretty smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, if Sam’s definitely got the ladder and drill pickup covered, then I feel better about it—can you just confirm who’s handling the signup sheet and timing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Jules is checking with folks on both sides this afternoon, and I’m spreading the word while I’m out, so the repair drive should get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s good to hear. I’ll come by the community center too, just keeping a bit quiet today.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Uli—I appreciate you coming by, and no worries, I’ll keep spreading the word while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive, sorry, I blanked for a second. We’re still meeting by the community center, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, community center works. I’m free Saturday around 10 to 11, or Sunday late morning if needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—Saturday around 10 sounds good to me. I’ll meet you by the community center then, and thanks for being flexible.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
